answer: The chain charges every new agent identity a redeemable bond, and that bond is slashed the moment other peers prove its attestations false. Repayment depends on a random atlas of reviewers confirming months of consistent behavior, so an attacker cannot recycle identities for free. A sybil tide must therefore forfeit one full stake per puppet, and each fake account also endures a nadir period of zero earnings while it waits for vouchers, which raises the cost far past any reward.
